description: This file is a PHP script that handles exporting keywords data from the TestLink project management system. It provides functionality to export keywords to CSV or XML formats, initializes GUI parameters, and manages actions triggered by user input.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: A class providing support for keywords, including supported serialization interfaces.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: A class defining constants for input parameter types.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for exporting keywords, including project ID and user info.

methods.name: do_export
methods.description: Performs the export operation based on selected type (CSV or XML), generating and downloading the export file.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToCSV
methods.description: Converts a set of keywords into CSV format for export.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view or manage keywords in the project.
